summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on restructuring digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) inventory. The goal is to separate one frame from an existing facility and move it into a newly created, virtual facility.

**Key actions discussed:**
*   A new facility must be created in the system.
*   One specific frame needs to be detached from the original facility and linked to this new facility.
*   The names of the frames can initially be kept identical for simplicity, with name updates planned later.
*   No traffic data should be copied into the new virtual facility, as it is assumed to lack sensors and therefore no historical traffic data.
decisions: Create a new facility record in the system.
Relocate one frame from the original facility to the newly created facility.
action_items: Ensure no traffic data is copied into the virtual facility.
